text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock C after a steep fall locked in a large loss; I should set clear rules for when to reassess or exit a holding instead of reacting only after a decline.","Selling part of Stock A after it rose secured some gains, but I should base trims on my target allocation and reasons for owning it, not on gains alone.","My account fell for several periods despite holding five stocks, so I should monitor overall exposure and avoid assuming that diversification by itself keeps risk low."]}
